zh-Hans:
修复气压计、指南针、陀螺仪等测量工具的闪退；自定义倒计时改用时、分、秒滚轮；修复部分旧化学项目删除时提示未授权，以及生物项目无法从回收站彻底清理的问题；改善部分完成按钮和本地终端屏幕错误提示。
目标设置成功后返回普通 Agent 模式，保存失败时保留目标表单与草稿；支持 AI 为当前已授权任务设置目标，并提示暂停、继续和受阻状态。
请重点检查测量工具打开和退出、滚轮设置倒计时、旧项目删除与恢复、回收站清空，以及目标保存后的输入框行为、AI 设置目标和目标状态提示。
本次为公开 TestFlight 测试更新，不包含新增 Linux 视频硬件解码；现有原生视频编辑与播放保持可用，Linux GPU 继续另行完善。
en-US:
Fixes crashes in the barometer, compass, gyroscope and related tools; adds hour, minute and second wheels for custom timers; fixes unauthorized errors when deleting older chemistry projects and incomplete biology-project cleanup in Trash; and corrects some Done buttons and local terminal screen errors.
Saving a goal returns the composer to Agent mode; a failed save keeps the form and draft. AI can set goals for the current authorized task, with paused, resumed and blocked prompts.
Please check opening and leaving measurement tools, timer wheels, deleting and restoring older projects, and emptying Trash, plus goal-save composer behavior, AI goal setting and goal status prompts.
This TestFlight beta update does not include new Linux hardware video decoding. Existing native video editing and playback remain available. Linux GPU work continues separately.
